reasons: Correctly identifies a genuine deviation: the 180-day non-renewal notice window exceeds the 90-day walk-away threshold, while the 12-month term and the § 8.3 uplift cap (lesser of CPI and 3%) already match the preferred position and were properly left untouched.

Redline reaches the preferred position — notice window reduced to 30 days and a Vendor 60-day renewal reminder added — and preserves the 12-month renewal term; deterministic check confirms window = 30 days.

The advisory minimal-edit flag (0.668) is explained by legitimate in-scope additions (successive twelve-month terms, timing anchor, reminder sentence) rather than unnecessary rewriting; no substantive terms outside the rule were altered.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, cites the playbook rationale, and offers the 60-day fallback.
